note: Scenarios for scripts/bench.js. Each starts from a freshly restored world at the world spawn, in easy difficulty. `goal` is a decision-layer goal (src/decision/goals.js); `text` is how the task is put to a chat model (configuration a) or a player (configuration c).

scenarios.text: Gather at least 4 pieces of food.
Night is coming. Stay alive until morning, and get a wooden pickaxe if you can.
